summary: assess_file is a synchronous command doing filesystem I/O; a UNC or offline mapped drive blocks the IPC thread (window may freeze)
evidence: commands.rs:87-90 sync #[tauri::command]; tauri-macros wrapper.rs:50,257-260,398-430 runs body inline; VirusesPage.svelte:63-67 calls it per finding via Promise.all; get_system_overview and scan_start use spawn_blocking
failure_scenario: Scan \\nas\share, then the share goes offline: each assess_file waits for the SMB timeout, serially. UNVERIFIED: that Tauri 2 runs sync commands on the UI thread on Windows (from documentation, not traced).
